summary.interpretation: Fixed public-method profiles evaluated by ordinary grader. Behavior mixture/attention propensities are author assumptions, not learned human response probabilities; raw assignments do not use persisted prior-grade retention.

limitations: Repeated profile observations are dependent. No human-population significance or confidence claims.
Concept knowledge depends on the author review ledger; synthetic separation is not human semantic validity.
Different grade contracts may be non-monotonic under a limited method; flags are not proof of a bug.
Undefined variance is null; perfect controls are trivial correctness controls, not calibrated grade stability.
No thresholds/responders were tuned after the measured experiment.
